description: Returns a paginated list of Riddles. With the default scope "project" they come from a single project - use projectId to name it, or omit it for the project the API key is scoped to. With scope "account" they come from the entire account instead: the personal project and every team project the user has access to, in one list - the account-wide listing is this scope, not a tool of its own; projectId and notType do not apply there and are rejected rather than ignored. Every other filter works the same in both scopes. Answers with {items, page, pageSize, total, hasMore}, where "total" is how many Riddles match the filters in total and "hasMore" whether another page follows.

notType.description: Exclude specific Riddle types (array of strings, same valid values as type). Omit to exclude nothing. Scope "project" only - the account list has no exclusion filter.

origin.description:
Filter by how the Riddle was created: "api" (Riddle Builder API or Riddle AI) or
"manual" (made in the Creator). Omit for both. A filter value only - the "origin"
returned per Riddle is {builder, aiGenerated, writableByThisKey}; what
that means for writes: riddle://reference/concepts/access.

page.description: Page number, 1-indexed, 12 Riddles per page (default: 1). Zero or negative is rejected with a VALIDATION_ERROR rather than clamped.

projectId.description: Filter by project ID, as returned by project_list. Omit to use the project the API key is scoped to (your personal project for a user API key). Scope "project" only.

scope.description: What to list: "project" (default) for the Riddles of a single project, "account" for every Riddle of the account at once.

search.description: Search term to filter Riddles by title

status.description: Filter by status: "published", "modified", or "draft". Omit to include all statuses.

tags.description: Filter by tag IDs (array of integers). Omit to ignore tags.

type.description: Filter by Riddle type (array of strings). Valid values: "Quiz", "Poll", "Form", "Personality", "Predictor", "Minigame", "Leaderboard", "Placeholder", "Story". Omit to include all types.

name: riddle_list
